items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 15 at 8:41AM PST until November 16 at 7:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 6 to 11 ft.

* WHERE...Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM PST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 15 at 3:43AM PST until November 17 at 4:00AM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 20 to 25 ft, with occasional sets
of 25 to 35 ft at favored breakpoints.

* WHERE...All Pacific Coast Beaches.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...High tides will result in flooding of low-lying
infrastructure, isolated road closures, and coastal erosion.
Rising tides will bring water and waves farther up the beach
than normal, restricting escape from beaches and coastal areas.
Dangerously large breaking waves can overpower swimmers, pulling
people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks resulting
in significant physical injury and increasing the risk of
drowning. Waves can sweep across the shoreline without warning,
pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks.
items.instruction:
Swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf
conditions.
